name: io.github.sumirati/mcp-gitlab
title: GitLab MCP Server
description: Developer-ready GitLab MCP server for CE and EE instances.

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitLab Personal Access Token with api scope

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: GitLab instance API URL (defaults to https://gitlab.com/api/v4)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Enable read-only safety mode (true/false, default: false)

environmentVariables.name: GITLAB_TOOL_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domain whitelist to restrict registered tools and preserve context window tokens (e.g. 'repositories,merge-requests,issues')
